indicator.notConfiguredDescription: Fiskaly credentials are missing. Contact an administrator.

setup.pageSubtitle: Authenticate FinanzOnline, then initialize the SCU and cash register. The PIN is never stored.
setup.tenantRequired: Select a tenant in the header first.
setup.loadFailed: Fiskaly setup status could not be loaded.

setup.noCashRegisters: No cash registers found for this tenant.

steps.cashRegisterHint: Initialize the cash register at fiskaly

test.pageSubtitle: Development only: sign a synthetic receipt with fiskaly SIGN AT. This does not create a POS payment.
test.devOnlyHint: These test endpoints return HTTP 404 outside Development.
test.noInitializedRegisters: No initialized cash register for this tenant.
test.nullbelegVsStartbeleg: Nullbeleg: a €0.00 receipt to test the signature chain — can be created any time and does not commission the register. Startbeleg: the first RKSV receipt when commissioning a cash register, only once per register, required before Monatsbeleg and Jahresbeleg.

scenarioHints.cancellation: CANCELLATION with a negative amount. Does not create a POS storno.
scenarioHints.zero_amount: Nullbeleg: NORMAL with €0.00 and VAT rate NULL.
scenarioHints.raw: Minimal raw payload: €10.00 STANDARD via gross_amount_standard. Use only if standard_v1 is rejected.
scenarioHints.monthly_close: Creates a real RKSV Monatsbeleg for the last completed Vienna calendar month. Requires an existing Startbeleg. The current unfinished month is not allowed. Duplicate months are rejected.
scenarioHints.yearly_close: Creates a real RKSV Jahresbeleg for the last completed Vienna calendar year. Requires an existing Startbeleg. Duplicate years are rejected.
scenarioHints.tagesabschluss: Submits the existing TSE-signed daily closing for the selected cash register as a €0.00 NORMAL marker. Does not create a new closing. If no closing exists for the Vienna calendar day, the test fails.

errors.startbelegRequired: This cash register has no Startbeleg. Create a Startbeleg first.
errors.duplicateStartbeleg: A Startbeleg already exists for this cash register.
errors.duplicateMonatsbeleg: A Monatsbeleg already exists for this month.
errors.duplicateJahresbeleg: A Jahresbeleg already exists for this year.
errors.duplicateOrDecommissioned: The receipt already exists or the cash register is decommissioned.
errors.invalidPeriod: Year or month is invalid. Use a Vienna calendar period.
errors.periodNotCompleted: Monatsbeleg can only be created for completed (past) Vienna calendar months. The test uses the previous month.
errors.fiskalyLiveBlocked: Signing tests are blocked against LIVE.
errors.registerNotInitialized: The cash register is not INITIALIZED at fiskaly.
errors.specialReceiptFailed: The special receipt could not be created.

history.retryConfirmBody: The original request will be sent again to Fiskaly/RKSV. Already successful fiscal receipts are not duplicated when the service detects them.
history.retryForbidden: You do not have permission to retry.
history.empty: No operations for the selected filters.

errors.searchPlaceholder: Search error message or receipt number
errors.reviewFailed: Review status could not be saved.
errors.loadFailed: Error analysis could not be loaded.
